meta.purpose: Keyword and phrase inventory from real HK pathology dictation for TTS/synthesis coverage.

priority_legend.test_only: Appears in held-out test but not current SFT train unique texts. Highest synthesis value.
priority_legend.dev_only: Appears in real dev groups (13297/13342) but not train. Useful if you want thyroid/staple-line coverage.
priority_legend.train_and_test: Already in train, still needed so synthesis matches test phrasing.
priority_legend.train_only: Present in train; still useful to increase acoustic diversity.

notes: Counts are unique-utterance hits after dropping raw/denoised duplicates.
Dev is listed because thyroidectomy and staple line live there, not in train.
Do not copy test transcripts verbatim into synthesis prompts.
For alphanumeric IDs, synthesize the PATTERN (e.g. 26SS#####, 12###) rather than the test IDs themselves.
